name: Lawn Chair
blurb: The suburbs at their most cooperative. Enemies are forgiving. The HOA still isn't.
flavor: You brought a folding chair and a cooler. The adventure will pace itself. The back pain will not.

name: Weekend Warrior
blurb: Standard suburban adventure. Two days off. One objective. No excuses.
flavor: The descent is what it is. The neighbors are what they are. Everything is fine. It is fine.

name: HOA Approved
blurb: The neighbors are watching. They have concerns. They have filed those concerns in triplicate.
flavor: A certified letter arrived this morning. It was about you. The descent will be less forgiving than the letter.

name: Dad Mode
blurb: Everything is a test. The HOA voted unanimously. You are the problem.
flavor: The remote controls everything. Everything controls you. The thermostat laughs. Quietly. Smugly.
